questions.prompt: Explain your position on the familiar social choice, support it with a supplied detail and acknowledge a reasonable alternative.
questions.context:
A new member can meet a helpful acquaintance today or a close relative tomorrow. The acquaintance has already offered help today; the relative has not replied. You prefer today because of the explicit offer. Acknowledge the alternative and the fact that silence does not establish unwillingness.
Familiar meanings available: human relationships; interpersonal; amiable; cordial; although; but; however.
